suggestCaption: Tap to close tabs from site

web_siteBody: Open TabTools and click a site under Suggestions, or right-click within a web page and choose Close site tabs. This closes matching tabs across your regular windows, including the current tab.
web_storeAria: {label} — opens the {store} in a new tab
web_structuredDescription: A free browser extension for closing tabs by site, sorting tabs, removing duplicates, and clearing inactive tabs.
web_close_tabs_from_the_same: Close tabs from the same website, sort tabs by site, and remove duplicates. TabTools is a free browser tab manager for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.
web_tabtools_close_tabs_by_site: TabTools — Close Tabs by Site & Sort Your Tabs
web_close_tabs_by_site_sort: Close tabs by site, sort your tab bar, and clear duplicates with a free, open-source extension for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.
web_clear_a_website_s_tabs: Clear a website’s tabs in one action, or sort your tab bar by site. TabTools also removes duplicates and clears inactive tabs in Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.
web_free_to_use_no_account: Free to use. No account needed.
web_viewing_on_a_phone_or: Viewing on a phone or tablet? Open this page on your computer to add TabTools.
web_see_tabtools_close_tabs_by: See TabTools close tabs by site, remove duplicates, sort tabs, and clear inactive tabs.
web_from_the_popup_or_right: from the popup or right-click menu
web_your_tab_list_stays_in: your tab list stays in your browser
web_clear_a_finished_task_bring: Clear a finished task, bring tabs from the same website together, or tidy repeated and inactive pages.
web_bring_tabs_from_the_same: Bring tabs from the same site together in your current window, with the sites you have open most placed first.
web_close_extra_copies_of_the: Close extra copies of the same page in one click. Pinned tabs are left in place.
web_type_a_word_to_match: Type a word to match tab titles and URLs, or enter an exact domain such as youtube.com. Then choose Close.
web_choose_an_inactivity_threshold_in: Choose an inactivity threshold in Settings, then click Inactive to clear eligible tabs. Active, pinned, and audible tabs stay open.
web_start_with_one_busy_site: Start with one busy site. Use the popup for site suggestions and sorting, or the right-click menu for a quick close.
web_open_the_chrome_firefox_or: Open the Chrome, Firefox, or Edge store page and add the free extension.
web_click_the_tabtools_icon_in: Click the TabTools icon in your browser’s extensions menu to see site suggestions and quick actions.
web_close_a_site_or_sort: Close a site or sort your tabs
web_click_a_site_under_suggestions: Click a site under Suggestions to close its tabs, or choose Sort tabs to bring tabs from the same site together.
web_the_tabtools_extension_processes_tab: The TabTools extension processes tab information on your device. Settings and cleanup statistics stay in your browser’s local storage. The extension has no accounts, analytics, advertising, or external database.
web_yes_tabtools_is_free_to: Yes. TabTools is free to use. No account is needed.
web_which_browsers_can_i_use: Which browsers can I use it with?
web_tabtools_is_available_for_chrome: TabTools is available for Chrome, Firefox, and Microsoft Edge. To add it on your computer, use the browser links on this page to open the right store.
web_how_do_i_close_tabs: How do I close tabs from the same website?
web_right_click_within_a_web: Right-click within a web page and choose “Close site tabs,” or open TabTools and click the site under Suggestions. This closes that site’s tabs across your regular windows, including the current tab. You can also enter a keyword or exact domain in the popup.
web_can_i_remove_duplicates_or: Can I remove duplicates or clear inactive tabs?
web_yes_choose_close_duplicates_to: Yes. Choose Close duplicates to remove repeated pages, or click Inactive to close eligible tabs. You can change the inactivity threshold in Settings; cleanup happens when you choose the action.
web_does_tabtools_collect_or_share: Does TabTools collect or share my data?
web_the_extension_processes_tab_informat: The extension processes tab information locally and does not send it to the developer or third parties. Settings and cleanup statistics stay on your device. This website’s demo is hosted by YouTube; the embedded player and browser stores have their own privacy policies.
web_use_undo_immediately_after_closing: Use Undo immediately after closing tabs from the TabTools popup, while the popup is still open. You can also use your browser’s recently closed tabs to reopen pages.
web_free_for_chrome_firefox_and: Free for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge
web_close_tabs_by_site_sort_2: Close tabs by site, sort your tab bar, and clear duplicates.
